newsitem.title: HAITI: Police among 15 hurt at Haiti student protest.
newsitem.headline: Police among 15 hurt at Haiti student protest.

text.p: Fifteen people were injured Wednesday, including five police officers, when rock-throwing Haitian students and security forces clashed during a protest against the declining quality of education, police chief Yonel Trecil said.
Police dispersed the crowd by shooting into the air and spraying the students with gas.
Students began protests Monday after public schools closed for a week due to strikes by teachers demanding back pay, higher wages and better conditions.
